atupaṟṟip piṉṉōrāṉa aṟiñarkaḷ, avai pāṭappaṭṭa can
tarppaṅkaḷum tiṇai tuṟaikaḷum viḷaṅkak kuṟippukkaḷiṭṭu oru
kōvaippaṭat tokuttutaviṉar. aṅṅaṉam tokuttiṭṭa
nūlkaḷē 'eṭṭuttokai' eṉap pirapalamāka vaḻaṅkuvaṉa.

ṟittiṟatta veṭṭut tokai"

ēṉaiyōr nūlkaḷāka iyaṟṟiyavai iṉṉaveṉpatu teriya

u
mukavurai.
pāṭalkaḷaip piṉṉōrporuṭṭut tokuttutaviya paṇṭaip
perumakkaḷiṉ aruñceyalai nām peritum pārāṭṭal takum
nāṭṭil aṅkaṅkē citaṟi vaḻaṅkiya taṉippākkaḷai muyaṉṟu te
kuttuk kuṟippukkaḷuṭaṉ iṉṉōr namakkaḷittilarēl, caṅkakāla
ttuppulavarkaḷiṉ arumaippeyarkaḷaiyēṉum, perumaicceyti
kaḷaiyēṉum, muṟkālattu nilaimai nikaḻccikaḷaiyēṉum nām
ciṟitēṉum aṟiya iṭamuṇṭō?ivvāṟē iṭaikkālattum
piṟkālattum vāḻnta tamiḻpperumakkaḷiṉ taṉippācuraṅkaḷum
ettaṉaiyō vaḻaṅkiyiruttalvēṇṭum. avaiyellām, ap
pulavarpeyar mutaliyavaṟṟōṭu perumpālum maṟaintoḻintaṉa.
itaṉkāraṇam, muṉṉōrpōla avaṟṟaip piṉṉōrum cēmit
tut tokuttutavat tavaṟiyatēyām. ataṉāl, caṅkattiṉ
piṟkāla vaḻakka oḻukkaṅkaḷaiyum araciyal mutaliya nilaimaikaḷai
yum nām aṟintu makiḻtaṟku iṭamillaiyāyiṟṟu. tamiḻkkup
pērupakāramāṉa ivvariyaceyalai namakku muṉṉiruntōr nekiḻa
viṭṭatu nam tavakkuṟaivēyākum. iraṇṭu mūṉṟu nūṟṟāṇṭu
kaṭkumuṉ tamiḻnāvalarcaritai eṉṟa peyarāl tokukkappaṭṭa
ciṟiya ceyyuṭṭiraṭṭoṉṟu ippōtu veḷivantuḷatu.
nūliṉiṉṟu, kūttar kampar mutaliya pulavarperumakkaḷiṉ ariya
varalāṟukaḷcila namakkut teriyavarukiṉṟaṉa. āyiṉum paṉṉū
ṟāṇṭukaṭkuriya tamiḻcceytikaḷai aṟitaṟku ittiraṭṭuc ciṟi
tum pōtiyataṉṟu. iḵtaṉṟit taṉippāṭaṟṟiraṭṭuppōṉṟa
nūṟṟokutikaḷum ivvakaipaṟṟi namkālattu eḻuntaṉavē.
avai, piṉṉōrāṉa pulavarpāṭalkaḷaiyē perituṅ koṇṭaṉ
vākavum, paḻampāṭal palavaṟṟaip piṟaḻnta caritakkūṟukaḷuṭaṉum
pāṭaṅkaḷuṭaṉum veḷiyiṭuvaṉavākavum amaintaṉa. ataṉāl,
aṟiñarkaḷatu ārāyccikkuriya piramāṇa nūlkaḷeṉṟu avaṟ
ṟaic colvataṟkillai. iṅṅaṉamāka, mattiyakālam piṟkālaṅka
ḷukku uriyatāy, paḻamaiyāṉa kuṟippukkaḷuṭaṉum pāṭaṅkaḷuṭa
ṉum iyalpeṟa amaikkappaṭṭa taṉicceyyuṭkōvai takkatāka
ituvarai kiṭaittilatu eṉṟē collalām. ikkuṟaiyai
ōraḷavil nīkkutaṟkeḻuntatē ittokai nūlākum.

=== 7 ===
vaḻakkamāyuḷḷatu.
paṇṭai ilakkiya ilakkaṇa nūluraikaḷiṟ paḻakivarum
aṟiñarellām, avaṟṟil mēṟkōḷākavum piṟavāṟākavum āḷap
paṭṭuḷḷa paḻañceyyuṭkaḷ perumpālavum coṟceṟivum
poruṭpolivu muṭaiyavāy iṉpampayappaṉa eṉpatai naṉkaṟi
var. avvāṟu ciṟantuḷḷaṉavēṉum nūlkaṟpōr appāṭalkaḷai
utāraṇavaḷaviṟkoṇṭunōkki nekiḻaviṭuvatē neṭuṅkāla
appāṭalkaḷellām atikāravaṭaivil
vaittut tokukkappeṟiṉ aḵtu oru ciṟanta ilakkiyamāki,
muṉṉōriṉ arumaiperumaikaḷai nammavar aṟintu makiḻtaṟku
iṭamākum eṉṟa eṇṇam palavāṇṭukaṭkumuṉ eṉakkut
tōṉṟiyatu. ataṉāl tolkāppiyam yāpparuṅkalam kārikai
vīracōḻiyam mutaliya ilakkaṇa nūlkaḷiṉ paḻaiya uraikaḷiṉiṉ
ṟum, muṟkālattavum piṟkālattavumāṉa ilakkiyavuraikaḷiṉiṉ
ṟum kiṭaitta taṉippākkaḷaiyellām tokukkalāṉēṉ.
immēṟkōṭpāṭalkaḷuḷ orupakuti ippōtu ac
cēṟiya nūlkaḷiṟ kāṇakkūṭiyaṉavāyiṉum, uraikārarkālattu
vaḻaṅki ippōtu peyarteriyāta nūlkaḷiṉiṉṟu utakarikkap
paṭṭa ceyyuṭkaḷum avaṟṟiṟ pala uḷa. avaṟṟuḷḷē veḷi
vanta nūṟpāṭalkaḷai viṭuttu, iṉṉanūleṉṟu teriyāta
utāraṇacceyyuṭkaḷum, uraiyāḷarkaḷāṟ peyarkūṟi
āḷap
paṭṭu ippōtu kiṭaittaṟkariyavāyuḷḷa pāratam takaṭūryāt
tirai muttoḷḷāyiram āciriyamālai mutaliya nūṟpāṭalkaḷumē
itaṉuṭ kōkkappaṭṭaṉa. ivaṟṟōṭu paṟpala puttakacālaikaḷi
lum piṟarpālumuḷḷa ēṭṭuppiratikaḷālum, pattirikaikaḷālum
teriyavanta paḻampāṭalkaḷum cērntaṉa. paramparaippulavarkaḷ
mūlamākavum piṟa tamiḻmakkaḷ mūlamākavum vāymoḻiyākak
kiṭaitta taṉikkavikaḷum pala. ivaiyaṉṟi, cilā tāmira cāsa
ṉaṅkaḷil aracar periyōr mutaliyavaraippaṟṟiyum paṟpala
aṟacceyalpaṟṟiyum muṉṉōr arumaiyākap pāṭippoṟitta
ceyyuṭkaḷaiyellām kiṭaittavaḷavil tiraṭṭi innūluṭ
cērttuḷēṉ. iṅṅaṉamākat tokutta pāṭalkaḷiṉ mottat
tākai 3500kku mēṟpaṭṭatākum. ivaṟṟai - kaṭavuḷ vāḻttu,
aṟaviyal, poruḷiyal, iṉpaviyal, oḻipiyal eṉa aintiyalka
ḷāka vakaippaṭutti innūl amaikkappeṟṟatu.
